items.verify:
- Wise 收加密平台法币｜Wise Help Centre（2026-10-26 查阅）：可接收受监管加密平台款项，但「we're not able to accept any payments from Binance」；不可用加密货币充值/付款 https://wise.com/help/articles/2932118/incompatible-accounts-and-payments
- Wise 收款手续费｜Wise 定价页（2026-10-26 查阅）：本地非 Swift/wire 收款免费；USD wire/Swift ==$6.11==、GBP Swift ==£2.16==、EUR Swift ==€2.39== https://wise.com/us/pricing/receive
- 小火箭后量子加密｜OpenClash #5216 / Shadowrocket 2.2.78（2026-10-26 查阅）：机场称 Shadowrocket ≥2.2.78 可在 设置→TCP→指纹 勾选 X25519MLKEM768 以支持后量子；2.2.78 changelog 写 feat(vless) 添加 VLESS Post-Quantum 加密 https://github.com/vernesong/OpenClash/issues/5216 https://blog.shadowrocketsub.com/post/changelog-2-2-78/
